property_summary: After calling XBornID() which sets balances[owner]=totalDistributed, the reference contract P leaves totalDistributed unchanged (still 200000000e18) because XBornID does not call distr, while the buggy contract M with inverted canDistr condition causes getTokens() to revert when called by an owner not blacklisted, but the immediate assertion is that totalDistributed in P equals 200000000e18 and in M after the same call also equals 200000000e18; however the observable divergence is that a subsequent call to getTokens() by a non-blacklisted user succeeds in P but reverts in M due to the inverted require(distributionFinished) in canDistr, making distributionFinished remain false in P and true in M, so the assertion address(c).balance after a msg.sender sends ether succeeds in P (balance increases) but reverts in M, causing a revert that we detect via try/catch—so the concrete scenario is: owner calls XBornID() then a non-blacklisted user calls getTokens{value: 0}; in P it succeeds, in M it reverts.
change_summary: Replace require(!distributionFinished) with require(distributionFinished) to invert the condition.
